titulo: The map of generators in Oct 2026 and how to choose
lead: Video generators change versions every few months and sometimes disappear, like Sora. That's why the choice doesn't start with the ranking: it starts with what your shot asks for. Duration, dialogue, reference, and license decide; the dated table just shows who meets the need today.
objetivo: choose the generator for each shot based on what it asks for (duration, dialogue, reference, license) and record the choice with the date.

aprende.t: The five questions that choose the generator for a shot
What each major generator offers in Oct 2026, with source and date
Why the Sora case teaches you to keep everything outside the platform
Record the choice in a file that the page checks

hero_alt: Wall of a dark editing room with six monitors side by side, each showing a different version of the same street with a lit bakery window.

secoes.sub: The shot decides the generator, not the other way around. Click each question.

nos.detalhe: How long the shot lasts in your shot list. A 4 s shot fits in any generator; a 25 s sequence in a single generation narrows the choice (in Oct 2026, Seedance 2.5 reaches 30 s).
If the shot has dialogue or a synced effect, prefer a generator with native audio. As of Oct 2026, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.5, Runway Gen-4.5 and LTX-2.5 return sound together with the image.
If the shot needs the same Dona Lia as the previous shot, count how many reference images the generator accepts and whether it accepts first and last frame. Lesson 5 goes deeper.

Closed = you use it through the platform and follow its terms. Open = the weights run on your machine, but each license has limits (Apache 2.0 is free; LTX's community license has a revenue cap). Lesson 7 covers this.
Where you already have an account, how much it costs per second, and whether your machine can run the open model. Prices and plans change fast: check the tool's page on the day.

secoes.legenda: Answer all five for the shot, not for the whole film: different shots can go to different generators.

secoes.titulo: The generators as of Oct 2026 (table updated on 10/19/2026)
secoes.sub: Only what has a dated source. Anything not confirmed appears as "reported." Tap each one.

texto: Native audio, with dialogue and effects. Accepts up to 3 reference images (the "Ingredients" feature), first-to-last frame transition, and scene extension.
Duration per clip: the numbers going around come from third parties and were not confirmed on an official page. Veo 4 has not been announced.
Released in February 2026: up to 15 s per generation, native audio in several languages, and dialogue with more than one character.
Omni controls duration, angle, and movement shot by shot. The character "elements" and the cut limit per generation are reported by third parties, without official confirmation.

exemplo.texto: Kling AI announcement (02/05/2026); Adobe blog on Firefly (04/15/2026).

texto: Up to 30 s with audio generated in the same pass. Accepts up to 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audios as references.
It replaced 2.0. Version 2.0 caused controversy with the US film studios' association for generating real actors and characters: a reminder that references have an ethical limit (course 2).
Gen-4.5 gained native audio, multiple shots in one generation, and videos up to 1 minute in December 2025.
Aleph 2.0 edits a video that already exists by text: remove or add an object, swap the background, change the light. The release date of Aleph 2.0 is reported, not confirmed.
Ray3.14 (January 2026) generates in native 1080p, faster and cheaper than the previous one.
Ray3 Modify changes footage based on a character image and start and end frames. Native audio in Ray: not confirmed.
The last Wan with open weights, under Apache 2.0. Versions 2.6, 2.7, and 3.0 exist only as a closed service.
The 5B version runs on 8 GB VRAM cards with ComfyUI's memory offloading, according to the official documentation. Details in lesson 7.
Open weights with video and audio. LTX-2.5 brings several shots in one generation. The LTX-2.x community license allows commercial use at no cost below US$ 10 million in revenue per year.
The ComfyUI documentation calls for a card with 32 GB or more of VRAM and 100 GB of free disk space.

exemplo.texto: LTX-2.5 page on Hugging Face and LTX documentation (checked on 10/19/2026).

texto: The app closed on 04/26/2026 and the API on 09/24/2026. Anyone who kept their script, references and prompts only inside it lost the way back.
The lesson applies to any generator: everything that is yours stays in a folder outside the platform, as text. No lesson tells you to use Sora.

exemplo.texto: OpenAI help center on the Sora shutdown (2026).

exercicios.titulo: Choice · one shot from your scene
exercicios.texto: Take the hardest shot in your shot list (the one with dialogue, or the one that needs the same character). Answer the five questions and fill in the escolha.txt using the template. Open the page of the tool you chose and note the date you checked it. Paste it into "Check your choice" and use "Download the file" to save it in the project folder.
exercicios.pronto: the page answers OK: choice with 8 fields and the escolha.txt is in the project folder, next to geradores-out-2026.txt.

exercicios.titulo: Portability · the folder outside the platform
exercicios.texto: Check that the project folder has, in text, everything you would need to redo the scene in another generator: storyboard, character sheet, look, and the escolha.txt. Anything that only exists inside a platform, copy it to the folder now.
exercicios.pronto: the project folder has storyboard.txt, ficha.txt, look.txt and escolha.txt, and all four open in a plain text editor, with no account on any platform.

secoes.sub: Four questions. The explanation shows up after each answer.

perguntas.p: Which of these questions comes before choosing the generator for a shot?
opcoes: Which generator is first in this week's ranking.
Which generator other creators in your niche are using.
What the shot needs: duration, dialogue, reference and license.
Which generator has the nicest, fastest interface.
perguntas.explica: Rankings and trends change every few months. What the shot needs is stable: if it has dialogue, it needs native audio; if it repeats a character, it needs a reference. Different shots can go to different generators.

perguntas.p: What does the Sora case teach someone who generates video with AI?
opcoes: Keep the script, references and prompts in text, outside the platform.
Use only open generators, because closed ones always end up going offline someday.
Avoid any generator released by a big tech company.
Generate everything at once while the tool is still online.
perguntas.explica: The app shut down on 04/26/2026 and the API on 09/24/2026. People who had everything inside it lost their way back. Closed doesn't mean forbidden; the safeguard is the portable folder, which lets you switch generators without losing your work.

perguntas.p: In the table, why does Veo 3.1's duration per clip appear as "not confirmed"?
opcoes: Because Veo 3.1 has no duration limit per generation, on any plan.
Because the number circulates on third-party sites, not on an official page.
Because the duration changes depending on the language used in the prompt.
Because Google forbids publishing clip durations.
perguntas.explica: The rule of the course is to state as fact only what has a dated source. A number that only shows up on aggregators goes in as "reported" or "not confirmed", and you check it on the tool's page that day.

perguntas.p: You want to run the video on your own machine and sell the result to a small client. What should you check first?
opcoes: Whether the model has the most downloads this month.
Whether the model generates in 4K, because clients demand high resolution.
Whether the model is the same one the big studios use.
The license of the weights and how much VRAM the model needs.
perguntas.explica: "Open" doesn't mean "free for everything": Wan 2.2 is Apache 2.0, LTX-2.x has a community license with a revenue cap, and some weights are for non-commercial use only. And without enough VRAM the model won't even run.

itens.texto: Duration, sound and dialogue, reference, license and access. Answer per shot.
Every version goes with "(Oct/2026)" and the date you checked it. What has no source is "reported".
Script, character sheet, look and prompts in text, outside the platform. Sora showed why.
